description: Two independent random voltage generators, each noise through a bandpass filter whose centre frequency and Q are set by knob and CV

params.text: Sets the centre frequency of that channel's bandpass filter, about 1Hz fully counter-clockwise to 4000Hz fully clockwise
Sets the Q of that channel's bandpass filter, 1 to 30, which narrows the band and makes the output more nearly a wandering sine
Attenuates and inverts the CV at the Fc jack for that channel before it is added to the Fc knob
Attenuates and inverts the CV at the Q jack for that channel before it is added to the Q knob

inputs.text: Moves the centre frequency of that channel's filter through the trim knob above it
Sets the Q of that channel's filter through the trim knob above it

notes: the trim knobs above the Fc and Q jacks come up at zero, so a cable at either changes nothing until its trim is turned off centre
menu: Extra Low Frequency — in this build it changes only how many digits the frequency display shows; nothing in the audio code reads it and the filters do not move
